description: Debug-only: exposes the MCP bridge plugin to the Tauri MCP server for DOM/CSS inspection during development. This file lives OUTSIDE the auto-discovered capabilities/ directory on purpose (the build-time glob is capabilities/**/*), so it is never compiled into the static ACL. It is registered at runtime via Manager::add_capability under #[cfg(debug_assertions)] in lib.rs setup, so release builds never grant mcp-bridge to any window.
